operation_classes.audit_lookup: GET audit lookup over FastAPI HTTP boundary.
operation_classes.enter_in_error_rebuild: POST cancellation / enter_in_error transition + THSS rebuild over FastAPI HTTP boundary.
operation_classes.governed_decision_reconstruction: GET governed decision reconstruction over FastAPI HTTP boundary.
operation_classes.invalidation_rebuild: POST cancellation / invalidation transition + THSS rebuild over FastAPI HTTP boundary.
operation_classes.reconstruction: GET decision / GLHS state reconstruction over FastAPI HTTP boundary.
operation_classes.snapshot_compile: POST snapshot compilation (THSS) over FastAPI HTTP boundary.
operation_classes.transition: POST proposal + POST transition over FastAPI HTTP boundary down to PostgreSQL commit.

primary_analysis.endpoint: Full-stack HTTP boundary latency (p50, p95, p99), throughput (tps), SQL read/write query counts, write amplification, CPU percent, and RSS memory measurement across all 7 operation classes with N >= 100 repetitions per class.
primary_analysis.fail_closed_criteria: Any missing operation class or sample size N < 100 renders the benchmark non-claim-eligible.
primary_analysis.tail_statistic_invariant: N >= 100 per operation class is mandatory for headline tail statistics (p95, p99). Runs with N < 100 fail claim eligibility.
